answer: The gatehouse is Salt measurer brine pan proof countersigned by the crystal hall. Passing it takes each brine pan is a season of logged brine readings plus a signed salt record, so a, and every alias must pass alone. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 779 fakes need 779, at 92 POA each, totalling 71668 POA. Open the dawn and you find a clerk, open the gale and you find a bill, open the relic and you find a date. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
